messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — account signal for AcmeHealth. Usage down ~68% week-over-week for seat-based features, started Tuesday. Procurement lead swapped to Raj last week. :warning:
Jon (AE): Yikes. Do we have the time-series and top-3 endpoints impacted?
Maya (CSM): Quick snapshot attached in the convo (see link) — embeddings and chat API calls are the biggest drop. Prefix caching hit rate fell from 42% to 9%.
pulse-bot: [alert] account: AcmeHealth — 68% drop in avg daily tokens, triggered renewal-risk heuristic.
Elena (PM): Any known infra issues or billing flags?
Maya (CSM): No infra/billing: logs clear. Onboarding completion went green but last 2 enablement sessions had low attendance.
Priya (AcmeHealth): sorry — internal leadership shuffled. Raj is new procurement and wants to run a 2-week side-by-side with NovaAI. We're pausing some workflows while they evaluate.
Jon (AE): Thanks for the context, Priya. Can we get Raj into a quick 30m call this week? Want to surface performance vs price and the Can we cover SLA/attestation items?
Priya (AcmeHealth): Yes, I'll loop Raj in. He wants clear cost/latency comparisons and a pilot scope.
Leo (Solutions): If they're running a side-by-side, recommend a 2-week Dedicated trial with pinned model + KV cache enabled. We can baseline latency and per-token unit cost. I'll draft a config:
```
model: redwood-compat-3.5
quant: int8
cache: prefix_kv
routing: single-region-us-west
metrics: token_breakdown, p95_latency
```
Maya (CSM): Suggested playbook: 1) immediate re-engage Raj (owner: Jon) 2) offer a dedicated 2-week trial with metrics dashboard (owner: Leo) 3) propose an enablement drop-in to recover workflows (owner: Maya) 4) prepare competitive delta doc (owner: Jon/Elena). Any objections?
Elena (PM): +1. I'll assemble a short delta doc (latency/cost/observability) and highlight our fallback/resilience story.
Jon (AE): I'll schedule the call once Priya confirms Raj availability. Also recommend a limited discount on the dedicated pilot to keep evaluation apples-to-apples.
Priya (AcmeHealth): Raj's free Thurs 11am PT. He asked if you can show end-to-end pipeline perf, not just single-request p95.
Leo (Solutions): We'll include steady-state throughput and cache-warmed runs. Also include insight on batching impact.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Jon -> book Thurs 11am PT with Raj (owner: Jon). Leo -> prepare trial config + perf plan (owner: Leo). Elena -> delta doc (owner: Elena). Maya -> enablement invite + short script for the pilot. Deadline: prep by Wed EOD so we can send materials ahead.
Jon (AE): On it.
Leo (Solutions): Drafting perf plan now, will drop artifacts in the thread.
Elena (PM): Draft started — sharing bullet points by EOD.
Priya (AcmeHealth): Thanks team — Raj will join Thurs. He asked about data handling for the trial (we need a short compliance note).
Maya (CSM): We'll include a short note on data retention, KMS options, and audit logging.
Jon (AE): Also adding a one-page renewal timeline: if trial favors Redwood, we can lock Dedicated pricing before end of month. If they choose competitor, flag for retention playbook.
Maya (CSM): Noting risk level as "elevated" until trial completes. Will update renewal pipeline.
Priya (AcmeHealth): Appreciate the quick response.
Leo (Solutions): Dropping a quick perf checklist link in thread.
pulse-bot: [reminder] action items pending: Jon, Leo, Elena — due 1745318400.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop — please confirm when docs are uploaded.
Jon (AE): Uploaded calendar invite and agenda.
Leo (Solutions): Uploaded perf plan + runbook.
Elena (PM): Delta doc uploaded.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — we'll reconvene after Thurs call and update renewal risk status. :thumbsup:
